newsitem.title: PERU: Thousands riot in Peruvian prison, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Thousands riot in Peruvian prison, one dead.

text.p: One Peruvian prisoner was believed to have been killed and four others injured on Friday as some 3,000 inmates rioted at a maximum security jail in Lima, prisoners and police said.
About 300 police entered the San Pedro prison after the riot broke out at midday (1700 GMT), firing tear gas and gunshots as a helicopter flew overhead.
But about 2,000 inmates could still be seen on the prison roof by late afternoon, burning mattresses and shouting anti-police slogans at the officers.

"There is one dead man on the roof. It was from a bullet," one prisoner, who identified himself as "Africa," told a local radio station from a phone inside the jail. Other inmates held up signs saying: "There has been one death."

The San Pedro jail, with a long history of violence, houses 5,200 prisoners, most of whom are awaiting trial. The prisoners said they were protesting for better conditions and against the alleged kidnapping of one of their leaders.
